Phase 3 (Crisis): Silph Co under Rocket control.
Bars are where people talk freely about occupation.
Map 113 (Saffron Bar VIP):
Rewritten: Trash cans (E5, E4), stall peeks (E6, E7, E8),
mirrors (E9, E10, E11, E12), dancer NPC (E15).
Preserved: E13 item gift (Energy Powder, variable_id 99
gated -- mechanical gift, self_switch progression),
E14 item gift (water/dehydration -- mechanical gift),
E16 drinking game / hotel quest (all 11 blocks preserved
exactly -- switch 937/932 gated, complex branching).
Map 195 (Saffron Bar upstairs):
Rewritten: Trash cans (E7, E8), stall peeks (E4, E6),
mirrors (E9, E10, E11, E12).
Preserved: E13 bathroom hiding quest (9 blocks -- time
wait mechanic, choices, self_switch progression).
Maps 825, 829 (Saffron Bar event variants):
FULLY PRESERVED -- entire band quest / concert event.
All blocks kept verbatim: concert posters (\V[1]/\V[2]),
band member dialogue (keyboardist, singer, drummer,
manager, flute, harp, aguitar, eguitar), crowd reactions,
Meloetta encounter (829 E31), announcer (829 E22/E32),
Pokemon cries, switch-gated progression (1001-1025).
These are complex multi-stage quest events that must
not be altered.
Line length limit: ~42 characters per line.
